summary: This Form 8-K reports the completion of the company's use of a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) previously disclosed in November 2024, under which it issued 1,302,806 shares at $11.8351 per share for $15.4M gross proceeds to YA II PN, Ltd. It also notes inclusion in Russell 3000 and 2000 indices. These are routine operational updates, not a special situation. No terms for a transaction, strategic review, or material corporate event are present. Accordingly, this filing does not warrant classification as a special situation.
